<Elly>
"This appears to be the final
authorization station before
Central Control."<New><Emeralda>
"Console wants old code?"<New><Elly>
"Directive 0320, followed by
four separate authority
points."<New><Elly>
"The surviving archives
should contain them. We can
use whatever we recovered
and return for the rest."<New><Elly>
"Each value goes in alone.
But this place still believes
Zeboim is at war."<Close>

DIRECTIVE NUMBER REQUIRED
Enter directive number.
REGISTER LOCATION
Control and Research Annex
ACCESS: east service stairs<Close>

FOUR AUTHORITY CODES REQUIRED
Enter codes in order, A to D.
CREDENTIAL REGISTER
Materials Storage
ACCESS: east service stairs<Close>

LAUNCH AUTHORIZATION
Directive 0320 accepted.
All four authority codes
verified.<New>Defense Bay lift: unlocked.
Use the lift on the north
wall.<New>West bulkhead status is
displayed at the local
control panel.<Close>

DIRECTIVE 0320 ACCEPTED
A-2 B-5 C-8 D-4
AUTHORITY VERIFIED<New>Launch authorization
recorded.
North-wall lift unlocked.
Custodian defense: active.<New><Elly>
"The lift is working. But the
defense system is still
active..."<New><Elly>
"We'd better check our
equipment before we go down."<Close>

CODE ERROR
One or more entries are
incorrect.<New>Enter Directive 0320 first,
then each authority code in
order from A to D.<Close>

<Elly>
"Authorization is accepted.
The north-wall lift now leads
to the Defense Bay."<New><Emeralda>
"Gears are below. Emeralda
ready!"<Close>

DEFENSE BAY LIFT
Access locked.<New>Enter Directive 0320 and the
four authority codes at the
wall console.<Close>

WEST BULKHEAD
Local release required.<New>Use the west control panel
after the Custodian defense
system has been disabled.<Close>

<Elly>
"Enter 0320 first. Then A-2,
B-5, C-8, and D-4.
One value at a time."<Close>

<Elly>
"The defense system is down
and the bulkhead is open.
Central Control lies beyond
the fifth magazine."<Close>

CIVIL DEFENSE
SAVED DIRECTOR'S BRIEFING
The Adviser's Office has
requested increased military
readiness.<New>Shelter capacity is
unchanged.<Close>

DEFENSE PROCUREMENT AUDIT
ORDER: WARHEAD ADAPTER STUDY
AUTHORITY: STRATEGIC COMMAND
DATE: 6078<New>CIVIL PROGRAM HEARING
SHARED USE PROPOSAL
DATE: 6079<New>AUDIT EXCEPTION
STUDY WAS ORDERED BEFORE
CIVIL REVIEW HAD BEGUN<New>APPROVAL ROUTE
ADVISER'S OFFICE<Close>

DEFENSE BAY
ACCESS INSTRUCTIONS<New>Complete launch authorization
at the wall console to unlock
the north lift.<New>Authorization grants access
to the bay. It does not shut
down the Custodian defense
system.<New>The west bulkhead has a
separate control panel. Its
release is locked while
Custodian defense remains
active.<Close>

WEST BULKHEAD
ARCHIVED CIVIL DEFENSE REVIEW<New>This bulkhead separates the
control room from the reserve
magazines. Closing it does
not make this room a public
fallout shelter.<New>The shelter plan does not
provide enough space for the
civilian population. Sealing
the magazines will not
correct that shortage.<New>STRATEGIC ASSESSMENT
Limited strike, first strike,
and retaliation all lead to a
full nuclear exchange in the
current model.<New>Projected civilian survival
is too low to sustain
recovery.<New>DISPOSITION
Military readiness increased.
Report withheld from public
release.<Close>

LAUNCH ORDER CONTROL
DIRECTIVE 0320<New>CURRENT STATUS
Central Command: no
connection.
Recall order: not received.
Directive: active.<New>REVISION HISTORY / 6081
Previous instruction: suspend
a pending launch if contact
with Central Command is lost.<New>Replacement instruction:
carry out the pending launch
order unless a recall has
been received.<New>Revision authority: Prime
Minister's Adviser.
Expiration clause removed.
No review date.<Close>

LAUNCH DUTY REGISTER
SAVED RELEASE RECORD<New>Release authorized by:
Facility Director.
Director's signature:
verified.<New>Supporting orders:
Strategic access order.
Safety waivers.
Directive 0320 revision.<New>All supporting orders were
routed through the Prime
Minister's Adviser.<New>Adviser's signature on
release: none.<New>RECORD QUERY / MARA<New>Please send the authorization
for the Safety waiver. The
release record names the
director, but the waiver came
from the Adviser's Office.<Close>

<Elly>
"A video disk... This one
looks all right."<New><Elly>
"We could try playing it on
the computer to the right."<Close>

ZBC ARCHIVE
Insert a Video Disk.<Close>

ZBC NEWS ARCHIVE
RECORDINGS: 6081-6083<New>Video Disk accepted.
Starting playback...<Close>

Food is disappearing from the
capital's markets. Private
dining rooms in the wealthy
districts, however, remain
well supplied.<New>Aid groups have asked their
owners to release food and
fuel for public distribution.
Most have refused.<Close>

Meanwhile, the country's
wealthiest families are
buying private fallout
shelters.<New>Builders advertise gardens,
medical facilities, and
provisions to last for years.<Close>

Across the country, food
lines begin before dawn.<New>Children wait in the cold
outside distribution centers
with nothing left to give
them.<New>Farmland lies abandoned. Rail
deliveries to the poorest
districts have stopped.<Close>

In the capital, crowds from
poorer districts have set
fire to homes in wealthy
neighborhoods. Families have
been killed inside.<New>Police and military units
have withdrawn from several
wealthy districts. Further
fires are being reported.<Close>

Births remain below
replacement level.
Infertility and hereditary
illness are increasing.<New>Average life expectancy is
now approaching thirty.<New>Officials have warned
privately that the nation may
not survive another
generation.<Close>

ZBC ARCHIVE / NEXT RECORDING
EMERGENCY BROADCAST / 6083<New>We interrupt this program. A
nuclear missile has been
launched.<New>Retaliatory launches are
being reported by several
nuclear-armed states. We are
losing contact with military
command.<New>Take shelter immediately.
Anyone receiving this
broadcast, take shelter. This
is not a drill.<Close>
Received Video Disk<Close><Close>

<Elly>
"The other disks are too
badly damaged."<Close>
